t: Totally balanced bees for Mystical Agriculture and addons.
神秘农业及其附属的蜜蜂，平衡性「绝对」没问题。
This bee cannot be bred. Spawn egg is crafted from a $(l:bees/mod/bees/mystical_agriculture#inferium)Inferium Bee(/l) spawn egg using an infusion altar.
这种蜜蜂无法繁殖。它的刷怪蛋需要用注魂祭坛以一枚$(l:bees/mod/bees/mystical_agriculture#inferium)劣质蜜蜂(/l)刷怪蛋制作。
Converted from a $(l:bees/wild/ghostly)Ghostly Bee$(/l) using a soulium dagger.
用灵魂匕首将一只$(l:bees/wild/ghostly)恶魂蜜蜂$(/l)转化而来。
